author_source: project/Electrical Safety Series/10_All About Electrical Safety Electrical Injuries Shock Severity Hazard & Protecti（国内版）/src.py

points.K13: 危害：未接地、过载、坏工具
points.K14: 危害：用错防护、架空线、潮湿
points.K16: 防护：遮挡带电部件、上锁挂牌
points.K17: 防护：软线、关柜门、避潮湿
points.K19: 两种漏电保护器别混淆
points.K21: 电流型：流出流回比一比
points.K24: 区别二：电压型与电流型

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验楼走廊的配电箱旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a closed electrical distribution box in a university lab corridor and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，把用电安全讲个明白。

shots.scene: 闪电、人体、盾牌、漏电保护器四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a lightning bolt, a human body outline, a shield and a residual current device. No people.
shots.narration: 电的常识、伤害、防护和漏电保护。

shots.scene: 阿杰把仪器插头插进地上一个接满插头的插线板，旁边放着一瓶溶剂
shots.prompt_en: The young male student plugs an instrument into a crowded power strip on the floor next to an open solvent bottle.
shots.narration: 阿杰图省事，把仪器插在地上的插线板。

shots.scene: 插线板发热冒火花、旁边溶剂瓶的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an overheating power strip with a spark next to a solvent bottle, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 过载发热，旁边还有易燃溶剂。

shots.scene: 老李走过来拔下插头，摇了摇头
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks over, unplugs the instrument and shakes his head.
shots.narration: 老李拔下插头：用电可马虎不得。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 先从电是什么说起。

shots.scene: 黄色高压警示三角和心跳线图标
shots.prompt_en: A yellow electrical warning triangle next to a heartbeat line icon. No people.
shots.narration: 电是重大危险，能够致人死亡。

shots.scene: 欣欣翻开空白书本，旁边灯泡亮起
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot opens a blank book as a light bulb icon lights up beside it.
shots.narration: 懂电、知道危险，才能防住事故。

shots.scene: 发电站图标经电线连到实验楼
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a power station connected by power lines to a university lab building. No people.
shots.narration: 电是能量，从一处流向另一处。

shots.scene: 小圆点沿导线绕电池和灯泡跑成闭合圈
shots.prompt_en: Small glowing dots travel along a wire in a closed loop around a battery and a bulb. No people.
shots.narration: 电子沿导体，在闭合回路里流动。

shots.scene: 导线里的箭头流动，旁边安培表图标
shots.prompt_en: Arrows flowing inside a wire next to an ammeter icon. No people.
shots.narration: 电流是电荷的流动，单位是安培。

shots.scene: 电源、导线、台灯组成的完整回路
shots.prompt_en: A complete loop of a power source, wires and a desk lamp that is glowing. No people.
shots.narration: 电源、导线、用电器，连成电路。

shots.scene: 粗水管与细水管对比，细管里的箭头变慢
shots.prompt_en: A comparison icon: arrows flowing fast through a wide wire and slowly through a narrow resistive section. No people.
shots.narration: 电阻，就是对电流的阻碍。

shots.scene: 铜线、铝片、铁钉等金属图标，箭头顺畅通过
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a copper wire, an aluminum strip and an iron nail with arrows passing through easily. No people.
shots.narration: 金属电阻小，容易导电，是导体。

shots.scene: 仪器金属外壳经黄绿线连到接地符号
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an instrument's metal casing connected by a green and yellow wire to a ground symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 接地把外壳连到大地，防止触电。

shots.scene: 玻璃、陶瓷、塑料、干木图标挡住箭头
shots.prompt_en: Icons of glass, porcelain, plastic and dry wood blocking current arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 玻璃、陶瓷、塑料、干木，是绝缘体。

shots.scene: 电线的塑料外皮包住铜芯的剖面
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway icon of a power cord showing plastic insulation wrapped around copper cores. No people.
shots.narration: 绝缘体把电挡在该在的地方。

shots.scene: 触电小人和烧伤手掌图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a person pictogram receiving a shock and a hand with a burn mark. No people.
shots.narration: 触电身亡、电击、烧伤，是直接伤害。

shots.scene: 梯子上的小人被电一下后跌落的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person pictogram on a ladder getting a small shock and falling. No people.
shots.narration: 被电一下摔下来，是间接伤害。

shots.scene: 人体轮廓上的路径箭头、电流表、时钟三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a body outline with a path arrow, a current meter and a clock. No people.
shots.narration: 伤得多重，看三点：路径、大小、时间。

shots.scene: 时钟指针转动，人体轮廓颜色加深
shots.prompt_en: A clock hand turning while a body outline icon turns a deeper red. No people.
shots.narration: 电流越大、时间越长，伤得越重。

shots.scene: 家用插座图标旁有警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A wall socket icon with a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 电压不高，不等于没有危险。

shots.scene: 欣欣摇头，摆手示意别大意
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot shakes its head and waves a paw in warning.
shots.narration: 日常电源，同样可以致命。

shots.scene: 人体轮廓上手到手的电流线穿过心脏
shots.prompt_en: A body outline showing a current path from one hand to the other hand, passing through the heart. No people.
shots.narration: 电流经过心脏，最危险。

shots.scene: 人体轮廓上手到脚、头到脚两条线
shots.prompt_en: A body outline showing a hand to foot path and a head to foot path, both passing the heart. No people.
shots.narration: 手到手、手到脚、头到脚，都经过心脏。

shots.scene: 脚到脚的路径不经过心脏
shots.prompt_en: A body outline showing a foot to foot path that does not cross the heart. No people.
shots.narration: 脚到脚不过心脏，相对轻些。

shots.scene: 手握电线、肌肉僵住的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand clamped onto a live wire with tense muscle lines. No people.
shots.narration: 电流稍大，肌肉僵住，甩不开。

shots.scene: 心脏图标快速乱跳
shots.prompt_en: A heart icon beating rapidly and irregularly with zigzag lines. No people.
shots.narration: 再大些，心脏会乱跳、泵不出血。

shots.scene: 墙上的 AED 箱，老李取下
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer takes a defibrillator box down from the hallway wall.
shots.narration: 心脏骤停，几分钟内就会致命。

shots.scene: 受过培训的王老师在模拟人上使用 AED
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator, trained in first aid, places defibrillator pads on a training manikin.
shots.narration: 及时用AED除颤，能提高救活机会。

shots.scene: 接头乱缠、线径过细的线路图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of messy wiring with thin wires twisted together, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 线路不合格，是隐患。

shots.scene: 开着盖的接线盒露出带电接线，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an open junction box exposing live terminals, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 带电部件外露，一碰就触电。

shots.scene: 外皮开裂露铜的电线图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a power cord with cracked insulation and exposed copper, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 绝缘破损的电线，不能再用。

shots.section_title: 危害：未接地、过载、坏工具
shots.scene: 金属外壳仪器的插头缺了接地脚，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a metal-cased instrument with a plug missing its ground pin, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 设备和工具没有接地，是隐患。
overlay: 危害：未接地、过载、坏工具

shots.section_title: 危害：未接地、过载、坏工具
shots.scene: 插线板插满大功率设备发热图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a power strip filled with high-power appliances glowing red with heat. No people.
shots.narration: 电路过载，会发热起火。

shots.section_title: 危害：未接地、过载、坏工具
shots.scene: 外壳破裂的电钻图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an electric drill with a cracked housing, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 损坏的电动工具和设备，别再用。

shots.section_title: 危害：用错防护、架空线、潮湿
shots.scene: 普通线手套和绝缘手套对比，前者打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons comparing ordinary cotton gloves crossed out with a red X and proper insulating gloves with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 用错防护用品和工具，也是隐患。
overlay: 危害：用错防护、架空线、潮湿

shots.section_title: 危害：用错防护、架空线、潮湿
shots.scene: 校园里的架空电线和举着长杆的小人图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of overhead power lines on campus with a person pictogram raising a long metal pole toward them, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 架空电线附近，别举长杆、别攀爬。

shots.section_title: 危害：用错防护、架空线、潮湿
shots.scene: 水滴图标落在插座上，所有危害图标变红
shots.prompt_en: A water drop icon falling onto a socket, making the hazard icons around it glow red. No people.
shots.narration: 一沾潮湿，所有危害都更严重。

shots.scene: 接地符号图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: A ground symbol icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 防护第一条：接地要良好。

shots.scene: 配电箱里带试验按钮的漏电保护器图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a residual current protection device with a test button inside a distribution box. No people.
shots.narration: 装好漏电保护器。

shots.scene: 熔断器和空气开关图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a fuse and a circuit breaker. No people.
shots.narration: 用合适的保险丝和断路器。

shots.section_title: 防护：遮挡带电部件、上锁挂牌
shots.scene: 接线端子加装透明防护罩
shots.prompt_en: A clear protective cover being fitted over terminal blocks in a control box. No people.
shots.narration: 带电部件，要加防护罩遮挡。
overlay: 防护：遮挡带电部件、上锁挂牌

shots.section_title: 防护：遮挡带电部件、上锁挂牌
shots.scene: 老李拉下电闸、上锁、挂空白警示牌
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer switches off a breaker, locks it with a padlock and hangs a blank warning tag.
shots.narration: 检修前断电，上锁挂牌防误送电。

shots.section_title: 防护：软线、关柜门、避潮湿
shots.scene: 电源线整齐沿墙走、不被压不被拉扯
shots.prompt_en: A power cord neatly routed along a wall, not pinched under a door or stretched. No people.
shots.narration: 软电线不压、不拉、不打结。
overlay: 防护：软线、关柜门、避潮湿

shots.section_title: 防护：软线、关柜门、避潮湿
shots.scene: 配电柜门关好，阿杰想打开被王老师制止
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator stops the young male student from opening a closed electrical cabinet door.
shots.narration: 配电柜门关好，无关人员不碰。

shots.section_title: 防护：软线、关柜门、避潮湿
shots.scene: 湿地面上的插线板图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a power strip lying on a wet floor, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 潮湿的地方，避免用电作业。

shots.scene: 王老师给学生上用电安全课
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches electrical safety to a small group of students in front of a blank screen.
shots.narration: 接触用电作业的人，先要受培训。

shots.scene: 空白培训证书和带电符号图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank training certificate next to a lightning bolt icon. No people.
shots.narration: 懂危害、会防护、知道出事怎么办。

shots.section_title: 两种漏电保护器别混淆
shots.scene: 两个外形相似的漏电保护器图标并排，中间问号
shots.prompt_en: Two similar-looking residual current device icons side by side with a question mark between them. No people.
shots.narration: 两种漏电保护器，最容易搞混。
overlay: 两种漏电保护器别混淆

shots.section_title: 两种漏电保护器别混淆
shots.scene: 箭头从旧式图标指向新式图标
shots.prompt_en: An arrow pointing from an older style device icon to a newer style one. No people.
shots.narration: 电流型是升级版，已基本取代电压型。

shots.scene: 设备外壳的接地线穿过检测块的示意图
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram of a device casing whose ground wire passes through a sensing block before reaching ground. No people.
shots.narration: 电压型盯住设备外壳的接地线。

shots.scene: 相线碰壳，检测块亮起，开关断开
shots.prompt_en: The diagram shows a live wire touching the casing, the sensing block lighting up and the switch contacts opening. No people.
shots.narration: 一碰壳，地线上有了电压，马上断电。

shots.section_title: 电流型：流出流回比一比
shots.scene: 两根导线穿过一个圆环，流出流回箭头一样长
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of two wires passing through a ring sensor with equal current arrows going out and coming back. No people.
shots.narration: 电流型用一个环形互感器做比较。
overlay: 电流型：流出流回比一比

shots.section_title: 电流型：流出流回比一比
shots.scene: 天平图标两边平衡，显示零
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale icon perfectly level with a zero mark. No people.
shots.narration: 流出多少、流回多少，正常时一样。

shots.scene: 一部分电流经小人图标流入大地，回流箭头变短
shots.prompt_en: Part of the current leaks through a person pictogram into the ground, and the return arrow becomes shorter. No people.
shots.narration: 有人触电，一部分电流漏到地里。

shots.scene: 天平倾斜，圆环亮起，开关跳开
shots.prompt_en: The balance scale tips, the ring sensor lights up and the breaker trips open. No people.
shots.narration: 流出流回不相等，立即跳闸断电。

shots.scene: 两张空白名片分别贴在两个保护器上
shots.prompt_en: Two blank name cards attached to the two residual current device icons. No people.
shots.narration: 一个叫接地漏电断路器。

shots.scene: 第二张名片旁加一个小标签
shots.prompt_en: A small extra blank tag appears beside the second device's name card. No people.
shots.narration: 一个叫剩余电流断路器，也叫剩余电流装置。

shots.section_title: 区别二：电压型与电流型
shots.scene: 左边电压表图标，右边电流表图标
shots.prompt_en: A voltmeter icon on the left device and an ammeter icon on the right device. No people.
shots.narration: 一个看电压，一个看电流。
overlay: 区别二：电压型与电流型

shots.scene: 电压型保护器下的接地线断开，保护器变灰
shots.prompt_en: The ground wire under the voltage-type device is broken, and the device icon turns grey. No people.
shots.narration: 电压型离不开良好的接地。

shots.scene: 漏电没走地线、电压型不动作的图标，打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of leakage current bypassing the ground wire while the voltage-type device stays closed, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 电流不从地线走，它就不动作。

shots.scene: 电流型保护器在各种漏电路径下都亮起跳开
shots.prompt_en: The current-type device lights up and trips for leakage through different paths. No people.
shots.narration: 电流型不靠接地，从哪儿漏都能断。

shots.scene: 通风橱里的溶剂瓶旁有静电火花图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a small static spark near an open solvent bottle inside a fume hood. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃溶剂旁，一点静电火花就危险。

shots.scene: 小研把金属桶用导线接地后再倒溶剂
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student connects a grounding clip to a metal solvent container before pouring.
shots.narration: 倾倒时容器接地，慢慢倒。

shots.scene: 化纤衣物图标被打叉，棉质实验服打勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a synthetic fleece jacket crossed out with a red X and a cotton lab coat with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 穿棉质实验服，少穿化纤衣物。

shots.scene: 窗外乌云闪电，实验室里的精密仪器图标
shots.prompt_en: Dark clouds and lightning outside a lab window, with an icon of a sensitive instrument inside. No people.
shots.narration: 雷雨天，精密仪器容易被雷电损坏。

shots.scene: 老李按规定关闭仪器、拔下电源插头
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer switches off a sensitive instrument and unplugs it during a thunderstorm.
shots.narration: 按规定关机断电，拔掉不用的插头。

shots.scene: 雷雨中户外用电设备和楼顶的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of outdoor electrical equipment in the rain and a person pictogram on a rooftop during lightning, crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 雷雨时，别在户外和楼顶用电作业。

shots.scene: 夜晚实验室里仪器亮着灯，无人值守，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a dark lab at night with an instrument running and no one around, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 仪器不能随意无人通宵运行。

shots.scene: 王老师在空白申请表上签字，仪器上挂空白运行牌
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator signs a blank overnight-run form, and a blank running tag hangs on the instrument.
shots.narration: 确需过夜，先审批、挂牌、留联系人。

shots.scene: 保卫处值班员夜间巡查实验楼走廊
shots.prompt_en: The security officer walks along a lab building corridor at night with a flashlight on patrol.
shots.narration: 按时巡查，发现异常及时处理。

shots.scene: 实验室灯灭了，小研按下仪器开关到关的位置
shots.prompt_en: The lights go out in the lab and the female graduate student turns the instrument switches to off.
shots.narration: 突然停电，先把仪器开关关掉。

shots.scene: 来电后搅拌器、加热板自己启动的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a stirrer and a hot plate starting by themselves when power returns, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 否则来电时，设备可能自己启动。

shots.scene: 来电后小研逐台检查再开机
shots.prompt_en: Power returns and the female graduate student checks each instrument before switching it on one by one.
shots.narration: 来电后逐台检查，确认无误再开。

shots.scene: 宿舍和实验台上过夜充电的锂电池冒烟图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a lithium battery pack charging overnight on a desk and starting to smoke, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 锂电池过充、受损，会冒烟起火。

shots.scene: 原装充电器给电池充电，旁边有人看守
shots.prompt_en: The young male student charges a battery with its original charger on a non-flammable tray and stays nearby.
shots.narration: 用原装充电器，有人看着，充满就拔。

shots.scene: 鼓包的电池被放进专门的回收桶
shots.prompt_en: A swollen battery being placed into a dedicated battery collection bin. No people.
shots.narration: 鼓包、破损的电池，停用并回收。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前，板上是电流、心脏图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a whiteboard showing icons of a current arrow and a heart.
shots.narration: 电流过心最危险，低压也不能大意。

shots.scene: 破线、过载、潮湿三个图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Three icons crossed out in red: a damaged cord, an overloaded power strip and a water drop on a socket. No people.
shots.narration: 破线、过载、潮湿，都是隐患。

shots.scene: 接地、漏电保护器、锁和挂牌三个图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: a ground symbol, a residual current device and a padlock with a tag. No people.
shots.narration: 接地、漏保、上锁挂牌，层层防护。

shots.scene: 两个漏电保护器图标，一个连地线，一个连圆环
shots.prompt_en: Two device icons, one linked to a ground wire and one linked to a ring sensor. No people.
shots.narration: 电压型靠地线，电流型比电流。

shots.scene: 静电、雷电、夜晚、电池四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a static spark, a lightning cloud, a moon over a lab and a battery. No people.
shots.narration: 静电、雷雨、通宵、充电，也要当心。

shots.scene: 欣欣和老李、阿杰站在配电箱旁挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera together with the facility engineer and the young male student beside a closed distribution box.
shots.narration: 懂电才能用好电，下次见！
